readWith: text layer, with the collided rows read from the page

symptoms.symptom: Connection to home network is not established.

causes.label: WLAN on router is not active.
remedies: Check the wireless network connection of your router.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 48: "WLAN on router is not active."

symptoms.symptom: Special salt refill indicator lights up.

causes.label: Insufficient special salt.
remedies: Add Special salt.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 48: "Insufficient special salt."

causes.label: Sensor does not detect special salt tablets.
remedies: Do not use special salt tablets.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 48: "Sensor does not detect special salt tablets."

symptoms.symptom: Refill indicator for special salt does not light up.

causes.label: Water softening system is switched off.
remedies: Set the water softening system.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 48: "Water softening system is switched off."

symptoms.symptom: Refill indicator for rinse aid lights up.

causes.label: No rinse aid.
remedies: Add Rinse aid Page 23.
Set the amount of rinse aid to be dispensed.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 48: "No rinse aid."

symptoms.symptom: Refill indicator for rinse aid does not light up.

causes.label: Rinse aid system is switched off.
remedies: Set the amount of rinse aid.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 48: "Rinse aid system is switched off."

causes.label: Appliance door is not closed properly.
remedies: Close the appliance door.
Arrange the dishware so that no parts project beyond the rack and prevent the appliance door from closing properly.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 48: "Appliance door is not closed properly."

symptoms.symptom: All LEDs light up or flash.

causes.label: A software update is possibly installing.
remedies: Wait until the software update has been installed.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 48: "A software update is possibly installing."

causes.label: This process can take approx. 30 minutes.
remedies: If the appliance is not ready to use after 30 minutes,
perform a reset.
Press the main switch button for approx. 4 seconds.
Your appliance is resetting.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 48: "This process can take approx. 30 minutes."

causes.label: Electronics have detected a fault.
remedies: Press the main switch button for approx. 4 seconds. The appliance is reset and restarted.
If the problem occurs again:
Switch off the appliance.
Unplug the power plug or switch off the circuit breaker in the fuse box.
Wait at least 2 minutes.
Switch on the circuit breaker in the fuse box or plug in the power plug.
Switch on the appliance.
If the problem occurs again:
Contact customer service.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 48: "Electronics have detected a fault."

causes.label: A software update is available.
remedies: Press the remote start button to install the software update.
After a successful software update, "Suc" appears on the display for a few seconds.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 48: "A software update is available."

symptoms.symptom: Water is left in the appliance at the end of the program.

causes.label: Filter system or area under the filters is blocked.
remedies: Clean the Filters Page 38.
Clean the Drain pump Page 51.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 48: "Filter system or area under the filters is blocked."

causes.label: Program has not yet ended.
remedies: Wait until the program ends or terminate the program with Reset.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 48: "Program has not yet ended."

causes.label: The breaker has tripped.
remedies: Check the relevant breaker.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 48: "The breaker has tripped."

causes.label: Rinse aid has been spilled.
remedies: Remove the rinse aid with a cloth.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 48: "Rinse aid has been spilled."

causes.label: Detergent or machine care product used causes excessive foaming.
remedies: Change the brand of detergent.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 48: "Detergent or machine care product used causes excessive foaming."

causes.label: Connection to home network is not available.
remedies: Activate the wireless network connection on your router.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 48: "Connection to home network is not available."

symptoms.symptom: Home Connect cannot be implemented correctly.

causes.label: Home Connect set incorrectly.
remedies: Please consult the documents supplied for Home Connect.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 48: "Home Connect set incorrectly."

symptoms.symptom: Appliance cannot be switched on or operated.

causes.label: Software update is taking place.
remedies: Wait until the software update has finished.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 49: "Software update is taking place."

causes.label: Appliance functions have failed.
remedies: Pull out the power cord plug or switch off the breaker.
Wait at least 2 minutes.
Connect the appliance to the power supply.
Switch the appliance on.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 49: "Appliance functions have failed."
